title: Publicly listed DPWH budget rows with Miagao title matches
scope: Rows from ODV integrated project data whose project title contains the locality name Miagao or Miag-ao after punctuation normalization. This title search can omit projects listed only by barangay or another locality and can include corridor or district-wide works whose full physical footprint needs confirmation. FY2026 House GAB amendment rows are included as a separate stage and are not labeled as enacted GAA lines.
locationReference: PSGC names where titleBarangays is present; title mentions only, not surveyed project footprints
historicalSourceNote: 2017–2025 rows are GAA lines. 2026 rows are House GAB amendment records from the DPWH amendment schedule; they are shown separately by stage.
proposalNote: FY2027 records are from the House General Appropriations Bill, 3rd-reading extract. They are proposals, not enacted appropriations or verified completed work.
